title: Every 2026 AI release, ranked by usefulness
blurb: 20 releases scored on hype vs usefulness (out of 10) and sorted into tiers — from "the best" to "skip." Claude Code 2.1.0 is the most underrated; OpenClaw the most overhyped.
body:
20 of 2026's AI releases, each rated on hype vs usefulness (out of 10) and bucketed into tiers. The pattern: the most useful releases were often the least hyped.

The best

Claude Code 2.1.0 (most underrated, hype 3 / use 9) · Cowork (6/9) · Claude Opus 4.6 (8/9) · Claude Code Security (7/9).

Strong

Kling 3.0 · Claude Sonnet 4.6 · Code Remote Control (use 8).

Solid

GPT-5.3-Codex · Kimi K2.5 · Notion Custom Agents · Perplexity Computer (use 7).

Meh

Cowork Plugins · Copilot Tasks · Nano Banana 2 · Gemini 3.1 Pro · Seedance 2.0 — note Nano Banana 2 and Seedance carried hype 8–9 but landed at use 5–6.

Skip

MiniMax M2.5 · OpenAI Retired 6 · Qwen 3.5 · OpenClaw (most overhyped: hype 9 / use 3).

SOURCE · "Every 2026 AI Release Ranked by Usefulness" infographic.
